name: Move-out can keep the advance without changing the balance
title: SC-08-03-02 Move-out can keep the advance without changing the balance
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given departing Tenant "Zeynep Kaya" has 800.00 in the tenant advance ledger
When the Site Manager chooses to keep the advance during move-out
Then the tenant advance remains unchanged
